title: Rabbi Tanchum of Parod
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Avodah Zarah 31a relates that Rabbi Yochanan came to Parod and said, “Is there any teaching of Bar Kappara here?” Rabbi Tanchum of Parod recited one to him. Hyman infers from the passage that he was Bar Kappara’s student.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Avodah Zarah 31a paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Yochanan asking for a teaching of Bar Kappara and Rabbi Tanchum of Parod reciting it. The further conclusion that Tanchum was Bar Kappara’s student is Hyman’s inference; recitation alone is not admitted here as a teacher relation.
